==Usage==
<pre>{{DM|author=|editor=|date=|legacy=1}}</pre>

Or, instead of {{Para|editor}}, can use {{Para|smt}} set to "1" if an email from the [[Wookieepedia:Social Media Team|SMT]] accounts.

==Example(s)==
Test, using [[:File:MaleficentMeaningKarnak-AbelGPena-Facebook.png]]:
{{DM|author=Abel G. Peña|editor= Weedle McHairybug|date=2014-01-27|legacy=1}}
